$comment: ADAAAA-6031 labeled retrieval eval set (plan A3). Long-horizon retrieval: a store of prior stream facts plus a query set, each labeled with the relevant prior-fact ids a correct retrieval should surface. Queries model the REAL retrieval input — the current 60s window's salient facts at decide time (same entity refs + event-type tokens the facts carry: player #N (color), yellow/red card, goal, penalty, scoreboard). Each query carries >=2 relevant facts to make precision@k meaningful, reflecting the narrative use (e.g. a red-card decision must retrieve the player's earlier bookings). precision@k scored by FactMemory.query against these labels.
